The '''''Harrow''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] variant.

==Characteristics==
[[File:MarlSemtin.png|thumb|left|150px|The ''Harrow'' was commanded by Marl Semtin.]]

Unlike most ''Victory''-class vessels, the ''Harrow'' was powered by two primary engines and two vertically-lined secondary thrusters. The vessel had a single [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]].<ref name="XwRSBT" />

==History==
The ''Harrow'' was commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Marl Semtin/Legends|Marl Semtin]]. It was used in an attempt to recover a cache of loot and weapons stored by [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. During this attempt, it saw multiple [[Tatooine Campaign|engagements]] with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], until suffering a fatal explosive decompression as a result of several well-placed [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] from an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] of that [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]].<ref name="XwRSBT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Harrow'' resembles a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]]; the raised sections along the sides are reminiscent of the ''Victory''-class's atmospheric maneuvering fins. However, there are major differences. The ''Harrow'' had two main thrusters with two vertically placed secondary thrusters between them. Also, it bears a similar command tower and ventral terrace to the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]. In addition, the ''Harrow'' lacked a forward docking bay. It is unknown if ''Harrow'' is the result of design-differences in separate Rendili shipyards or just heavily modified from a stock ''Victory''-class Star Destroyer.
